title: Hub-First Company-Mapping Funnel Cross-Window Summary V1
interpretation: The first v3.3 holdout found plausible A-share expressions for 71% of hub-triggered causal clusters versus 29% in the 2016Q1 baseline window.
Company-level conversion evidence improved more modestly, from 29% to 43%, showing that finding a ticker is easier than closing the economic evidence chain.
Selection conversion doubled from 14% to 29% in the first v3.3 holdout, while 60d quality remained mixed: both selections had positive absolute returns but only one beat CSI300.
Cross-window differences in market regime and event mix prevent treating these rates as a causal estimate of v3.3 improvement.
strongestCurrentConclusion: The mapping loop is a promising way to raise opportunity frequency without adding more discovery feeds, but evidence closure—not ticker discovery—is now the dominant bottleneck.
nextValidation: Use an untouched pre-2013 window (2012/2011/2010 all currently show no project artifacts) with the v3.3 protocol frozen unchanged.
